messages:
Tom (AE): Heads-up: Solaris Labs just escalated to their CTO. They say the POC is blocked and want an exec bridge today. Main asks: Okta SSO failing for assertion audience mismatch, observed throughput drop when requests include long context (>1024 tokens), and procurement wants a month-to-month pilot price instead of annual commit.

Priya (Solutions): Can we list owners for each blocker? I can own the SSO handoff and the SAML metadata exchange. Need their IdP metadata and ACS URL.

Lee (SRE): I dug into the POC fleet logs. The audience mismatch looks like a SAML config issue (audience URI differs). On throughput: p95 doubles when sequence length >1200, likely due to KV cache thrashing. I can run a targeted perf with kv-size tweak.

Nina (Security): For procurement: they can accept SOC2 + our vendor questionnaire but legal insists on a filled security questionnaire for enterprise review. If they want BYO-KMS we need a data access addendum signed. Also: confirm TLS cert chain and cipher support.

Ken (Product): Quick product note: we have a mid-pass optimization (kv-window-adjust v1) that improved long-context p95 in internal tests. I can push a canary image if SRE signs off.

BridgeBot: Bridge created: https://bridges.redwood/BR-6421. Meeting tentatively scheduled 17:30 PT. Add agenda? Use /bridge update.

Tom (AE): Owners: Priya = SSO + metadata; Lee = perf + canary; Nina = security questionnaire + KMS path; Ken = rollout for kv-window-adjust. I'll coordinate the exec invite and include procurement rep.

Priya (Solutions): Solaris infra sent IdP metadata (sanitized) in their email. I'll paste minimal snippet here and DM the full XML to ops: <EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://idp.solaris/cert\">...</EntityDescriptor>

Lee (SRE): Starting perf job with kv-window-adjust v1 on a 2-node canary. Command:
```
./run_perf --target https://poc.solaris.redwood/generate --concurrency 80 --duration 120 --seq-len 1400 --kv-window 2048
```
Will post short results in 20m.

Nina (Security): Uploaded questionnaire template answers draft to: https://vault.redwood/drafts/solarislab-security-qna. Also uploaded TLS cipher list and KMS whitepaper. If they request HSM-backed BYO keys, legal needs to sign DPA addendum.

Ken (Product): Canary image pushed: image: redwood/inf-runtime:kv-window-v1. Routing policy set to 5% traffic for canary. No errors so far.

Lee (SRE): Quick perf tail: 
[2026-03-23T14:02:05Z] run=prf-115 p95=520ms p99=1.1s seq=1400 kv_miss=22%
[2026-03-23T14:04:10Z] run=prf-116 p95=340ms p99=680ms kv_miss=6% (after kv-window-adjust)
Seems the kv-window-adjust drops miss rate substantially for long contexts. I'll attach CSV when complete.

Tom (AE): Great. One-liner for the exec invite? Need something crisp.

Priya (Solutions): Suggest: \"Redwood will run a short canary with long-context optimizations, complete SSO metadata integration, and present a month-to-month pilot pricing option to close the POC.\"

Tom (AE): Perfect. Nina, can you confirm items we should send pre-bridge to Solaris execs?

Nina (Security): Send: SOC2 report, filled questionnaire draft, KMS options doc, and SSO metadata troubleshooting steps. I'll add a short note on BYO-KMS implications.

BridgeBot: Reminder scheduled: Bridge BR-6421 in 25 minutes.

Lee (SRE): Final perf summary (short): p95 improved from ~520ms -> ~340ms with kv-window-adjust; kv_miss reduced from ~22% -> ~6%. CSV: https://perf.redwood/runs/prf-115.csv

Tom (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll send the invite to Solaris CTO + procurement + our execs at 17:30 PT and attach the one-liner and artifacts. Follow-ups: Priya to finish SSO attr mapping, Lee to upload perf CSV, Nina to push questionnaire, Ken to monitor canary.

Priya (Solutions): I'll post the SAML attr mappings here shortly.

Ken (Product): Monitoring canary now; alert channel #canaries if regressions.

Tom (AE): Closing loop: if bridge goes well we offer a 60-day month-to-month pilot at pilot pricing with an option to convert to a 12-month commit with a discount. I'll include both in the deck.

BridgeBot: Bridge BR-6421 closed: notes uploaded.

Tom (AE): Post-bridge summary: Solaris CTO accepted the canary perf numbers and SSO plan. Procurement asked for final written pilot pricing; Rahul from pricing will draft and post in morning. Good job team.
